notes.title: Release of my 1st game "Don't Fall
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

It's with a mixture of excitement and apprehension that I present "Don't Fall", my very first game. As someone who is passionate about the world of video games, I'm embarking on this adventure with all my heart.

I must inform you that, as an independent game, "Don't Fall" may contain a few bugs. However, it's the culmination of a great deal of effort and investment on my part, and I'm delighted to share this experience with you.

I understand that the game may not be perfect, but I sincerely hope that you can enjoy it. Your support is invaluable, as it will enable me to improve "Don't Fall" and develop it further. I look forward to reading your feedback in the comments, whether positive or constructive.

Thank you for embarking on this adventure with me. Let the game begin and may luck be on your side!

Enjoy the game! 🚀🐸
